item.title: A message from Mr. Warner:
item.description: Congratulations to the junior girls' basketball team on a gritty effort last night against the PRBC Rockets U19 team. They ended up losing by four but showed tremendous resiliance and toughness. Next up is Le Sommet tomorrow at STA, then the Arnprior-Renfrew tournament this Friday and Saturday. Super proud of you girls - you represent STA with class!
